name: Appointment Sync — new-patient catch-up (every 10 min, scheduled)

nodes.name: Every 10 minutes
nodes.notes:
Ten minutes, not an hour, and that is a capacity decision rather than a
latency one. One execution reads ONE patient's whole history — the same
single unit of work the backfill used, with the same ledger, the same
truncation handling and the same proof that a unit was read. At hourly
that is 24 patients a day against a clinic that registers roughly twenty;
one busy week and the queue never drains. Every ten minutes gives 144 a
day for 6 requests an hour, which is nothing against the shared budget.

Most ticks find nothing to do and record a no-op success in well under a
second without touching DrChrono at all.

nodes.name: Run Now (manual)
nodes.notes: Same path as the schedule, including both gates.

nodes.name: Preflight: schedule + shared budget
nodes.notes:
The same two gates as the incremental workflow, reading the same budget
function, which is the point: two schedules each obeying a private cap can
still exceed the practice's shared DrChrono allowance. One number, both
schedules.

parameters.query:
SELECT sc.enabled, sc.cadence, sc.max_requests_per_run,
       b.may_run, b.reason, b.hour_remaining, b.burst_remaining
  FROM appointment_sync_schedules sc
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL public.drsnip_sync_budget() b
 WHERE sc.schedule_key = 'patient_catchup_hourly';

nodes.name: Enabled?
nodes.notes:
False branch ends with nothing written — a schedule that is off should
not manufacture failures.

nodes.name: Within shared budget?
nodes.notes:
False branch records outcome 'budget_exhausted' with zero requests, so a
deliberate skip is visible and is never read as a failure.

nodes.name: Record Budget Skip
nodes.notes: Counters and a reason string only.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO appointment_sync_runs
  (mode, scope_key, scope_detail, run_cutoff, coverage, outcome, finished_at, error_summary)
VALUES ('patient_catchup', 'patient_catchup',
        'skipped before any DrChrono request: shared budget',
        now(), 'patient_history', 'budget_exhausted', now(), $1)
RETURNING id;

nodes.name: Catchup Config
nodes.notes:
The whole bound, in one visible place. 'Catchup Config' is one of the
names the generated Project Page code resolves its config from, so the
same unit-tested code node serves this workflow unchanged.

parameters.jsonOutput:
{
  "scope_key": "patient_catchup",
  "mode": "patient_catchup",
  "strategy": "patient_history",
  "coverage": "patient_history",
  "lease": "5 minutes",
  "page_size": 50,
  "historical_start": "2000-01-01",
  "future_horizon": "2028-03-31",
  "window_days": 92,
  "practice_group_id": null,
  "verbose": true,
  "page_cap_note": "The cap that BINDS is $pageCount in Fetch Window's completeExpression. This n8n version ignores maxRequestCount.",
  "strategy_note": "NEW PATIENTS ONLY, and by construction rather than by a date filter. Seed Patient Probes inserts one appointment_sync_windows row per linked patient ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING, so the 2,035 patients the backfill already completed keep their 'complete' rows and are never re-read. Claim Next Window only ever picks up pending/partial/failed units, which after the backfill means exactly the patients who registered since. This is NOT another historical sweep and must never become one: scope_key is patient_catchup, strategy is patient_history, and no scheduled_window unit is planned here."
}

nodes.name: Open Run
nodes.notes: Opens a run row; run_cutoff comes from the database clock.

nodes.name: Claim Scope
nodes.notes:
Scope lease. ZERO ROWS = another historical run holds it.

NOTE: the lease is PER SCOPE, so it does NOT serialize this run against an
incremental run — they use different scopes. What protects the shared
evidence tables is the row-level staleness guard in the snapshot upsert,
which is covered by a cross-scope test.

parameters.query:
WITH claimed AS (
  UPDATE appointment_sync_state
     SET active_run_id    = $2::uuid,
         lease_expires_at = now() + $3::interval,
         updated_at       = now()
   WHERE scope_key = $1
     AND (active_run_id IS NULL
          OR active_run_id = $2::uuid
          OR lease_expires_at IS NULL
          OR lease_expires_at < now())
  RETURNING scope_key, watermark, watermark_meaning,
            history_complete, last_committed_generation
)
UPDATE appointment_sync_runs r
   SET watermark_before = c.watermark
  FROM claimed c
 WHERE r.id = $2::uuid
RETURNING r.id AS run_id,
          r.run_cutoff,
          c.watermark          AS watermark_before,
          c.watermark_meaning,
          c.history_complete,
          c.last_committed_generation + 1 AS next_generation;

nodes.name: Claimed?
nodes.notes: False = lock_contended. Stop; do not report success, do not touch state.

nodes.name: Linked Patient IDs
nodes.notes:
The only intake data this workflow can see. Used to discard unlinked
patients BEFORE anything is written.

nodes.name: Build Window Plan
nodes.notes: Deterministic plan. Re-running is idempotent against the window ledger.

nodes.name: Plan Window
nodes.notes:
One row per planned window; ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING so progress survives
re-planning. A null window_key is a no-op (patient_history strategy).

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO appointment_sync_windows (window_key, strategy, range_start, range_end)
SELECT $1::text, 'scheduled_window', $2::date, $3::date
 WHERE $1::text IS NOT NULL
ON CONFLICT (window_key) DO NOTHING;

nodes.name: Seed Patient Probes
nodes.notes:
Phase 2 only: queues a per-patient history probe for every linked patient
the sweep found nothing for. Guarded by strategy so it cannot fire during
the scheduled sweep, when most patients simply have not been reached yet.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO appointment_sync_windows (window_key, strategy, patient_source_id)
SELECT 'patient:' || v.patient_source_id, 'patient_history', v.patient_source_id
  FROM drsnip_linked_patient_ids v
 WHERE $1::text = 'patient_history'          -- guard: only when asked
ON CONFLICT (window_key) DO NOTHING;

nodes.name: Claim Next Window
nodes.notes:
Claims ONE unit. Zero rows = nothing left for this strategy.
alwaysOutputData keeps the chain alive so the run still finishes and
releases its lease when there is no work.

parameters.query:
UPDATE appointment_sync_windows w
   SET state            = 'running',
       attempts         = w.attempts + 1,
       first_attempt_at = COALESCE(w.first_attempt_at, now()),
       last_run_id      = $1::uuid,
       updated_at       = now()
  FROM (
    SELECT window_key
      FROM appointment_sync_windows
     WHERE strategy = $2
       AND (state IN ('pending', 'partial', 'failed')
            OR (state = 'running' AND updated_at < now() - $3::interval))
     ORDER BY window_key
     LIMIT 1
       FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
  ) s
 WHERE w.window_key = s.window_key
RETURNING w.window_key, w.strategy, w.range_start, w.range_end, w.patient_source_id, w.attempts;

nodes.name: Work Available?
nodes.notes: Both branches converge on Run Summary, so the lease is released either way.

nodes.name: Build Window URL
nodes.notes: Builds the read-only GET for this unit.

nodes.name: Fetch Window
nodes.notes:
READ ONLY GET.

THE PAGE BUDGET LIVES IN completeExpression VIA $pageCount. This n8n version
has no maxRequestCount option — it is accepted and silently ignored — so a
cap written there would not bind. 40 pages x 250 = 10,000 appointments per
unit; anything larger marks the unit partial rather than pretending to
have read it.

batchInterval spaces requests so a unit cannot trip the 10/second throttle.

nodes.name: Project Page
nodes.notes:
GENERATED — do not edit here. Built by lib/sync/build-code-node.mjs from the
unit-tested logic module plus the n8n glue, and shared verbatim with the
incremental workflow. Regenerate and re-paste after any change; a repo test
fails if they drift.

nodes.name: Upsert Snapshot
nodes.notes:
Idempotent. Refuses to be overwritten by an older revision, which is what
stops a historical read rolling back newer incremental evidence.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO appointment_snapshots
  (source_appointment_id, patient_source_id, doctor_source_id, office_source_id,
   profile_source_id, source_created_at, scheduled_time, source_updated_at,
   current_status, deleted_flag, archived, last_sync_run_id, practice_group_id)
SELECT $1::text, $2::text, $3::text, $4::text, $5::text,
       $6::timestamptz, $7::timestamptz, $8::timestamptz,
       $9::text, $10::boolean, $11::boolean, $12::uuid, $13::text
 WHERE $1::text IS NOT NULL
ON CONFLICT (source_appointment_id) DO UPDATE
   SET patient_source_id = EXCLUDED.patient_source_id,
       doctor_source_id  = EXCLUDED.doctor_source_id,
       office_source_id  = EXCLUDED.office_source_id,
       profile_source_id = EXCLUDED.profile_source_id,
       source_created_at = EXCLUDED.source_created_at,
       scheduled_time    = EXCLUDED.scheduled_time,
       source_updated_at = EXCLUDED.source_updated_at,
       current_status    = EXCLUDED.current_status,
       deleted_flag      = EXCLUDED.deleted_flag,
       archived          = EXCLUDED.archived,
       practice_group_id = EXCLUDED.practice_group_id,
       last_observed_at  = now(),
       last_sync_run_id  = EXCLUDED.last_sync_run_id
 WHERE appointment_snapshots.source_updated_at IS NULL
    OR (EXCLUDED.source_updated_at IS NOT NULL
        AND EXCLUDED.source_updated_at >= appointment_snapshots.source_updated_at);

nodes.name: Build Transitions
nodes.notes: Written after snapshots because of the foreign key.

nodes.name: Upsert Transition
nodes.notes: Replay-safe on (appointment, dedupe_key). Statuses stored verbatim.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO appointment_status_transitions
  (source_appointment_id, source_transition_id, transition_at,
   from_status, to_status, dedupe_key, observed_in_run_id)
SELECT $1::text, $2::text, $3::timestamptz, $4::text, $5::text, $6::text, $7::uuid
 WHERE $1::text IS NOT NULL AND $6::text IS NOT NULL
ON CONFLICT (source_appointment_id, dedupe_key) DO UPDATE
   SET last_observed_at   = now(),
       observed_in_run_id = EXCLUDED.observed_in_run_id,
       missing_since      = NULL;

nodes.name: Appointments With History
nodes.notes:
Only responses that actually carried a transitions array may flag history
as missing. An absent field is not evidence of removal.

nodes.name: Flag Missing Transitions
nodes.notes: Flags, never deletes.

parameters.query:
UPDATE appointment_status_transitions
   SET missing_since = now()
 WHERE source_appointment_id = $1::text
   AND $1::text IS NOT NULL
   AND missing_since IS NULL
   AND NOT (dedupe_key = ANY ($2::text[]));

nodes.name: Window Summary
nodes.notes: Per-unit outcome: complete, or partial when the page cap bound.

nodes.name: Finish Window
nodes.notes: Writes the durable checkpoint. completed_at is set only for 'complete'.

parameters.query:
UPDATE appointment_sync_windows
   SET state                  = $2,
       truncated              = $3::boolean,
       pages_fetched          = $4::int,
       appointments_seen      = $5::int,
       appointments_persisted = $6::int,
       appointments_discarded = $7::int,
       transitions_persisted  = $8::int,
       completed_at           = CASE WHEN $2 = 'complete' THEN now() ELSE NULL END,
       error_summary          = $9,
       updated_at             = now()
 WHERE window_key = $1
RETURNING window_key, state, truncated;

nodes.name: No Work
nodes.notes:
Keeps the chain alive so the run still records an outcome and releases
its scope lease.

nodes.name: Run Summary
nodes.notes: Run-level counters. watermark_after is ALWAYS null here.

nodes.name: Finish Run
nodes.notes: Counters and a sanitized summary only.

parameters.query:
UPDATE appointment_sync_runs
   SET outcome                = $2,
       finished_at            = now(),
       complete               = $3::boolean,
       coverage               = $4,
       watermark_after        = $5::timestamptz,
       committed_generation   = $6::bigint,
       requests_made          = $7::int,
       pages_fetched          = $8::int,
       appointments_seen      = $9::int,
       appointments_persisted = $10::int,
       appointments_discarded = $11::int,
       transitions_persisted  = $12::int,
       error_summary          = $13
 WHERE id = $1::uuid;

nodes.name: Release Lease
nodes.notes:
Releases the scope lease. The watermark CASE cannot fire because
watermark_after is null for every historical run.

parameters.query:
UPDATE appointment_sync_state s
   SET watermark = CASE
         WHEN r.complete AND r.outcome = 'success' AND r.watermark_after IS NOT NULL
           THEN r.watermark_after
         ELSE s.watermark
       END,
       last_run_id               = r.id,
       last_committed_generation = GREATEST(s.last_committed_generation,
                                            COALESCE(r.committed_generation, 0)),
       active_run_id             = NULL,
       lease_expires_at          = NULL,
       updated_at                = now()
  FROM appointment_sync_runs r
 WHERE s.scope_key     = $2
   AND r.id            = $1::uuid
   AND s.active_run_id = r.id
RETURNING s.scope_key, s.watermark, s.last_committed_generation;

nodes.name: Split If Truncated
nodes.notes:
Turns a capped unit into two claimable halves, so the sweep always makes
progress instead of retrying an oversized window.

nodes.name: Plan Split Children
nodes.notes: Inserts the halves of a split unit. A null window_key is a no-op.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO appointment_sync_windows (window_key, strategy, range_start, range_end)
SELECT $1::text, 'scheduled_window', $2::date, $3::date
 WHERE $1::text IS NOT NULL
ON CONFLICT (window_key) DO NOTHING;

nodes.name: Record Contention
nodes.notes:
Closes the losing run's row. drsnip_sync_budget() reserves a full per-run
allowance for anything still marked running, so an abandoned row would
shrink the shared budget for ever.

parameters.query:
UPDATE appointment_sync_runs
   SET outcome = 'lock_contended', finished_at = now(),
       error_summary = 'another run held the scope lease'
 WHERE id = $1::uuid AND outcome = 'running';
